title: Hitler's 188-tonne tank
caption:
Hitler wanted a tank nothing could stop. Physics agreed: nothing could move it either. 🐭
The Maus weighed about 188 tonnes, most bridges of the day took 20 to 60, and its top speed was about 13 km/h.
What's the most overbuilt thing you've ever seen?
sources: Wikipedia, Panzer VIII Maus (mass about 188 t; top speed about 13 km/h; two prototype hulls; never saw combat)
Tank Museum (Bovington), Panzer VIII Maus: designed to ford rivers submerged with a snorkel
